title: Learn Fruits for Kids! Apple, Banana, Watermelon and More with Pip
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're meeting five fruity friends.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Healthy food and healthy habits help us grow big and strong.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen!

lines: Here's a clue: it's round and crunchy, and it can be red, green or yellow! Can you guess?
This is Apple! Can you say apple?
Crunch, crunch! Apples are fun to bite.
Can you pretend to pick an apple from a tree? Reach up high!
Little seeds! They make a star shape.
One more time, nice and loud: APPLE!
Apples help keep your teeth and tummy happy.
Here's a clue: it's long and yellow, and you peel it! Can you guess?
This is Banana! Can you say banana?
Peel it down, down, down, and take a bite!
Can you pretend to peel a banana? Peel, peel, peel!
What color is a banana before it's ready?
Green! It turns yellow when it's ready.
One more time, nice and loud: BANANA!
Bananas give you energy to run and play.
Here's a clue: it's round, it's juicy, and it has the same name as its color! Can you guess?
This is Orange! Can you say orange?
Oranges are full of juicy pieces.
Each little piece is called a segment.
Can you make a big round orange with your arms?
Juicy slices! Like a little wheel.
One more time, nice and loud: ORANGE!
Oranges help your body stay strong.
Here's a clue: it's green outside and pink inside! Can you guess?
This is Watermelon! Can you say watermelon?
They are full of water. That's why they're so juicy!
Can you take a big pretend bite? Chomp!
What are the little black dots?
Seeds! Watermelons have lots of them.
One more time, nice and loud: WATERMELON!
Watermelon is a cool treat on a hot day.
Here's a clue: they're tiny, round and blue! Can you guess?
This is Blueberries! Can you say blueberries?
They are small, so you can eat a handful!
Can you count three blueberries on your fingers? One, two, three!
Blue! Well, a little bit purple, too.
One more time, nice and loud: BLUEBERRIES!
Blueberries are tiny but very good for you.

outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
